Definition

DEF-0001 Evoked compound action potential

TitleEvoked compound action potential
AbbreviationECAP
SourceREF-0003

Definition

The summed electrical response of the nerve fibres a stimulation pulse recruits, recorded at a sense electrode shortly after the pulse. Its amplitude measures how strongly the pulse activated the nerve.
